item: row 349: verify names a passphrase wrong only on an own-signed list (R803)
summary: Backup verify said the passphrase does not match whenever the key_check token in the volume list failed, though that token is protected only by a signature any key can make. Now the definite verdict needs R795's shared helper (a valid signature by this installation's own key); otherwise could not check the passphrase, with R795's reason, x12. ok and decrypted stay false; acceptance unchanged.
